// diagnostic

E1352

Source `{name}` is pinned and cannot be updated.

What

Source `{name}` is pinned and cannot be updated.

Why

D-CHANNEL-AUTO1 keeps a declaration with no channel marker pinned forever; an update command must not move its lock or rewrite its manifest.

Fix

Declare `{name}` with `#latest` for manual movement or `#auto` for automatic movement.
